title: Counit object is terminal in the right-slice pullback of a homotopy-2-category adjunction
statement:
Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, degreewise pullbacks, right-pinched mapping spaces and contractibility of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the right slice $\mathcal C_{/t}$ over a vertex with its source projection of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration]. Let $\mathscr K$ be a simplicial category (simplicial hom-sets, identity vertices, strictly associative unital simplicial composition) whose every hom-simplicial set is a quasicategory. Its homotopy $2$-category has the same objects, hom-categories the homotopy categories of these quasicategories, and composition induced by that of $\mathscr K$. Let $L\in\mathscr K(c,d)_0$ and $U\in\mathscr K(d,c)_0$, and let $\eta:1_c\to UL$ be an edge of $\mathscr K(c,c)$ and $\epsilon:LU\to1_d$ an edge of $\mathscr K(d,d)$ whose classes form an adjunction $L\dashv U$ in the homotopy $2$-category: writing whiskering as composition in $\mathscr K$ with a degenerate edge, $[\epsilon L]\circ[L\eta]=[1_L]$ in the homotopy category of $\mathscr K(c,d)$ and $[U\epsilon]\circ[\eta U]=[1_U]$ in that of $\mathscr K(d,c)$.

Fix an object $z$ and a vertex $a\in\mathscr K(z,d)$. Put $C_z=\mathscr K(z,c)$ and $D_z=\mathscr K(z,d)$, let $L_z:C_z\to D_z$ be the simplicial map of composition with $L$, let $q_a:(D_z)_{/a}\to D_z$ be the source projection of the right slice over $a$, and form the degreewise pullback
$$E'_z=C_z\times_{L_z,D_z,q_a}(D_z)_{/a}.$$
Its vertices are pairs $(b,\alpha)$ with $b\in C_z$ and $\alpha:L_zb\to a$ an edge of $D_z$. Let $Ua\in C_z$ be the composite of $a$ and $U$, and $\epsilon_a:LUa\to a$ the edge of $D_z$ obtained by composing $\epsilon$ with the degenerate edge at $a$; thus $(Ua,\epsilon_a)$ is a vertex of $E'_z$. Then $E'_z$ is a quasicategory and $(Ua,\epsilon_a)$ is terminal in it: for every vertex $(b,\alpha)$ of $E'_z$ the right-pinched mapping space $\operatorname{Map}_{E'_z}((b,\alpha),(Ua,\epsilon_a))$ is contractible.

source.place: Riehl--Verity, Observation 4.3.4 and Theorems 4.3.9 and 4.3.11, pp. 840--844 (terminality of the counit in the slice over a); right slice as in Kerodon 018F/01KX. Online source read; archival copy WANTED.
